thread:
laura (Compliance): Melissa from the audit firm asked for a compact evidence bundle for SOC2 that includes: (A) RBAC change snapshots for service account 'inference-runner' between 2025-11-01 and 2026-02-28 with approver proofs; (B) KMS rotation record for alias redwood-inference-prod and post-rotation validation; (C) break-glass emergency access timeline + who approved and STS assume logs. Need samples for 3 changes + one emergency event. Can we confirm what we can export and any redaction rules?

emma (SecOps): We can provide: git PRs from infra-iam (PR body + approvals), k8s rolebinding YAMLs from deploy artifacts, and normalized k8s audit entries (CSV). For KMS, CloudTrail events for RotateKey/CreateGrant/DisableKey + result of the automated decrypt test job.

mike (Infra): All k8s audit is in splunk (index=redwood-audit). RBAC infra changes are tracked in terraform in infra-iam repo. We have approvals on PRs (Git metadata) and the merge commit shows the author and merge timestamp.

auditor-melissa: For each RBAC sample we need: PR link, approver handle + timestamp, the applied manifest YAML, and the k8s audit line showing the binding action. For KMS, provide the CloudTrail event IDs, console-ARNs, and a short verification command we can run to decrypt a sample cipher (sanitized). For break-glass, need the runbook trigger, manager approval, and STS AssumeRole logs showing who assumed 'oncall-emergency'.

tom (SRE): Note: pre-2025-12-10 our audit ingest had a different field name for user.identity (we normalized to 'actor'). I'll include a short mapping doc. Also emergency flow creates a transient role 'oncall-emergency-<ts>' via automation, then we delete it after rotation. I'll include the role create/delete events and STS logs.

emma (SecOps): Example Splunk queries I'll export for the auditor: 
1) RBAC binds: index=redwood-audit sourcetype=k8s_audit objectRef.resource=rolebinding "inference-runner" earliest=2025-11-01T00:00:00Z latest=2026-02-28T23:59:59Z | table _time, actor, verb, objectRef.name, requestURI, responseStatus
2) STS assume logs: index=cloudtrail sourcetype=aws_cloudtrail eventName=AssumeRole "oncall-emergency" earliest=... | table _time, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, eventID
I'll produce CSVs for each.

mike (Infra): KMS events via CloudTrail CLI: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2025-11-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-02-28T23:59:59Z --query Events[].{Id:EventId,Time:EventTime,User:Username,Resource:Resources} 
Also include: aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/redwood-inference-prod and the key rotation status.

auditor-melissa: Redaction policy: remove personal email addresses but keep username handles and AWS account IDs. Replace any actual ciphertext with 'REDACTED_CIPHERTEXT' but include the decrypt command and sanitized output showing success/failure. Also include a mapping paragraph that ties artifacts to SOC2 CC6.1/CC6.2 (authz) and CC3.x (logging).

emma (SecOps): I'll prepare: artifacts_bundle.zip with folders: rbacsamples/{sample1,2,3}/ (PR.md, manifest.yaml, audit.csv), kms/{cloudtrail.csv, describe-key.json, rotation-test-sanitized.log}, breakglass/{timeline.pdf, approvals.csv, sts.csv}, plus retention_policy.md explaining Splunk retention and S3 lifecycle (we claim 3 years for audit indices).

laura (Compliance): Good. Please ensure PR.md shows approver GitHub handles and the GitHub approval timeline. For the manifest, include the exact patched YAML (kubectl apply artifact) not a templated Helm chart. Auditor wants applied artifact.

mike (Infra): We keep deploy artifacts in s3://redwood-artifacts/runs/ ; I'll pull the exact manifest blobs. Also will include the merge commit hash in PR.md.

auditor-melissa: For emergency event sample, include the justification text and the post-incident notes where we revoked credentials and confirmed no lateral access. A short attestation note from the manager who approved would be helpful.

tom (SRE): I'll add the revocation timeline: role revoke, key rotation if any, and the forensic snapshot references. Also note which hosts were scanned.

emma (SecOps): ETA: I'll upload presigned S3 link by Thu 18:00 PT. When packaging I'll: 1) hash user emails, 2) mask ciphertexts, 3) keep usernames and AWS account IDs.

oncall-bot: If upload not completed by 2026-06-03T01:00:00Z, I will remind #eng-security and page the oncall rotation.

laura (Compliance): Thanks — after upload I'll draft the control-mapping paragraph for each artifact and circulate for sign-off before we hand to the auditor.
